title: Here’s How to Watch 311: Live From Las Vegas Online
summary: Ahead of 311 Day (March 11), the rock band has two concerts livestreaming from Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas this weekend.
contentText:

Fans from all around the world can tune in to the 311: Live From Las Vegas concerts slated for Saturday, March 7 and Sunday, March 8 .

Ahead of “311 Day” on March 11, the concert events will livestream from Dolby Live at Park MGM in Las Vegas, with a start time of 11 p.m. ET/8 p.m. PT on Veeps. Read on for details on how to stream on Veeps online.

Want to attend the 311 concerts in person? There are still last-minute tickets available via Vivid Seats (get $20 off purchases of $200 and over with code BB30 ) and StubHub . Prices vary depending on the city and seats available. Moreover, you can save $150 off when you spend $500 with promo code BILLBOARD150 , or $300 off when you spend $1,000 with promo code BILLBOARD300 at TicketNetwork.com .

Meanwhile, those who want to watch internationally can access different the streaming service with a VPN , such as ExpressVPN or NordVPN .

You can watch 311: Live from Las Vegas on Saturday, March 7 and Sunday, March 8. Both nights start at 11 p.m. ET/8 p.m. PT. Each night goes for $16.99 apiece, or watch both nights for $19.99 per month on Veeps All Access.
